claim:spatial-colony.proposition: A spatial dynamic-FBA colony — flux-balance metabolism at every lattice site, coupled by diffusion — grows and accumulates an inhibitory acetate byproduct across space.

narrative.question: When flux-balance metabolism runs at every site of a spatial lattice with diffusion, does the colony grow and accumulate an inhibitory byproduct across space?
